issues.quote: net income grew 19.5% to $93.7 billion in fiscal 2025 from $93.7 billion in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Apple's fiscal 2025 net income was about $112.0 billion, not $93.7 billion. $93.7 billion is the fiscal 2024 figure. As written, the sentence has the same number for both years, which can't be a 19.5% increase. The 19.5% growth rate matches $112.0B against $93.7B.

data.summary: Not accurate as written: the fiscal 2025 net income figure is wrong. Revenue, gross profit, operating income, the margins, EPS and R&D all match Apple's reported results, but fiscal 2025 net income was about $112.0B, not $93.7B.
